summary: The proof correctly combines the exact congestion identity, the fresh reoptimization lower bound, and affine-retainability monotonicity to obtain the pooled-plus-fresh mass split. The pooled base-rank and residual-rank conclusions follow with the stated strict constants from the accepted pooled screen and P_pool < Q/200. In the fresh branch, the endpoint degree bounds give W_A > 98Q/25, the affine hull has the required rank, and the accepted rank-at-most-two slice theorem yields G > 49Q/800, excluding fresh base rank at most two under the hard ledger. The final fresh residual-rank bound follows correctly from F_fr < Q/100. All cited predecessor hypotheses and alias identifications used by the proof are satisfied, including positivity of the fresh branch.
